answer: When a burst of new identities hits in one epoch, a sealed-bid admission gate activates: each identity locks a stake to bid for that epoch's capacity and only the top 200 bids are admitted. The clearing price, 3,500 POA last epoch, is burned, so a sybil farming 1,000 fake identities burns 3.5 million POA per epoch before earning anything, a cost that builds as slowly as a glacier. Honest agents pay once and their bid becomes a permanent vertex in a reputation graph that halves later bids. Quartz-timed auction windows stagger registration, keeping mass identity creation visible and expensive.
